content.title: Montrose Environmental Group (MEG): Shares Trade Below Target as Profitability Challenges Persist
content.summary: Montrose Environmental Group (MEG) remains unprofitable, although losses have narrowed by 11.1% per year over the last five years. Revenue is forecasted to grow at 5.5% per year, trailing the broader US market’s projected 10.5% annual rate. With profit margins still in negative territory and no improvement recorded over the past year, the company continues to face the challenge of achieving profitability. Investors see a mixed valuation picture as shares trade below one estimate of fair value...

content.title: MEG Q3 Deep Dive: Organic Growth and Regulatory Tailwinds Drive Margin Gains
content.summary: Environmental services provider Montrose (NYSE:MEG) reported Q3 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 25.9% year on year to $224.9 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $820 million at the midpoint came in 0.6% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.36 per share was 11.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
